The '''F1-XD Autorepair Droid''' was a type of repair [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used as security forces by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A number of them were part of the security forces of [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The F1-XD Autorepair Droid appears a type of enemy in the Tactical Flashpoint "Depths of Manaan," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access. Similarly to the [[AD-4 Battledroid Centurion]], the F1-XD is given a generic name in the Solo Mode version of the Flashpoint rather than the designation used in the full version.<ref name="TOR" />
